title: Fresh holdout — NOT triggered (no controller variant shows a clear dev advantage over rule-basis)
triggerRule: Run a fresh holdout only if a controller variant has a CLEAR dev advantage over rule-basis (strictly positive on more paired scenarios than negative).

decision.reason: No controller variant beats rule-basis on paired dev land: A/B/C/D/F/G are EXACTLY identical to rule-basis endLand in all 12 scenarios (0/0/12), and E (hybrid) is exactly identical to run3-schema4 (0/0/12 vs run3) and below rule-basis (mean -2811.8, 5 pos / 6 neg). The candidate-control channel is provably neutral in this architecture, so no variant has a clear dev advantage to spend a fresh holdout on.
